runs.name: bounty-quests
runs.engineExecutionOwner: Root agent, serial invocation of tools/qa/run-client-smoke.ps1 against actual WORK engine.
limits: No private SAV or game resources loaded; synthetic actor type and quest dictionaries.
Contract-level failure marking only; actual liquidation sale and move flow is a separate integration gap.

scopeExclusions: Full is intentionally behind WORK by a latest image feature; no synchronization or production write.
Known deferred difficulty/chariot comment-vs-formula questions are not counted as new regressions.
Champion liberation event1295 retains original prize rules and page structure by approved scope.
Erza +3/-1 hooks are separately approved and are not an unauthorized-writer finding.
gaps: Full battle turn processing, battle renderer DOM and actual player mouse interaction were not covered by these two new native runs.
Payout amount and one-page structure were checked against exact current source; these two runs do not newly execute settlement -> result UI -> repeated forward -> return.
Full insolvency asset liquidation, valuation, actor clearing and relocation are not executed by the direct fail_quests contract test.
No personal SAV loading, CRC behavior or all old-save UI caches were tested.
The 8 group PNG files and single-image renderer source passed static/resource checks; this work does not claim a fresh native run of all 8 event return flows.
